title: China and Australia Arthropod Agricultural Pests 64-species x 16-locus design (PREPRINT-29 dimensions) vs. published arthropod phylogenomics
purpose: End-to-end seqnet -> RuNIE validation sweep at the dataset dimensions of PREPRINT-29 (china-australia-arthropod-pests-preprint): 64 species across 12 Arthropod families covering all major Australian and Chinese agricultural crop pests and 16 loci (12 mitochondrial PCGs + rrnL_16S + rrnS_12S + nuclear SSU_18S + LSU_28S). Final trees are scored against deep arthropod and holometabolan clades reported in the peer-reviewed studies below. A clade is testable when the run samples >= 2 tips inside and >= 2 outside it, and recovered when the unrooted tree contains the corresponding bipartition.

design_reference.taxon_design: 4 Chelicerata outgroups (4 Tetranychidae spider mites), 6 Polyneoptera migratory/plague locusts (6 Acrididae), 18 Paraneoptera sap/rasping-sucking pests (3 Thripidae thrips, 6 Aleyrodidae whiteflies, 5 Aphididae wheat/crop aphids, 4 Delphacidae planthoppers), 7 Coleoptera ambrosia & grain weevils (7 Curculionidae incl. Euwallacea fornicatus PSHB), 10 Diptera quarantine fruit flies (10 Tephritidae incl. Bactrocera tryoni, Ceratitis capitata, B. dorsalis), 5 Lepidoptera Yponomeutoidea diamondback/crop moths (2 Plutellidae, 1 Praydidae, 1 Yponomeutidae, 1 Lyonetiidae), and 14 Lepidoptera Obtectomera defoliators & borers (2 Pieridae, 4 Crambidae, 8 Noctuidae incl. Spodoptera frugiperda, Helicoverpa armigera, H. punctigera).
design_reference.taxonomy_note: Sectors [A]-[G] remain strictly monophyletic under the arthropod backbone ([A] Chelicerata Tetranychidae, [B] Acrididae, [C] Paraneoptera, [D] Coleoptera Curculionidae, [E] Diptera Tephritidae, [F] Yponomeutoidea, [G] Obtectomera Pieridae+Crambidae+Noctuidae). Priority Australia/China focal pest binomials are selected first from seqnet assembled OTUs and Entrez queries.
design_reference.locus_interpretation: 14 mitochondrial loci (12 insect/acari PCGs + rrnL_16S + rrnS_12S) + nuclear SSU_18S + LSU_28S = 16 orthologous phylogenomic loci. Xenobiotic detoxification CYP6 P450s, neurotoxic VGSC/AChE targets, swarming CSP/OBP proteins, and diapause HSP/GST chaperones are analyzed separately in Stage 4 codon-selection sweeps.

support.statement: Deep Paleozoic split separating Arachnida/Acari (Tetranychidae) from Pancrustacea/Hexapoda
Insecta monophyletic relative to Chelicerata outgroups
Polyneoptera (Orthoptera Acrididae) sister to Paraneoptera + Holometabola
Holometabola strongly recovered as a monophyletic superorder
Coleoptera placed within basal Holometabola sister to Neuropterida / Panorpida
Diptera forms a robust crown radiation paired with Amphiesmenoptera
Yponomeutoidea and Obtectomera united in crown Lepidoptera Ditrysia
Pieridae, Pyraloidea/Crambidae, and Noctuoidea form crown Obtectomera
Acrididae recovers as a cohesive Caelifera locust radiation
Schizophoran Tephritidae fruit flies form a monophyletic family
Spodoptera and Helicoverpa unite inside crown Noctuidae

report_only_clades.name: Paraneoptera (Thysanoptera + Hemiptera)
report_only_clades.why_not_scored: Johnson et al. (2018) showed Condylognatha (Thysanoptera + Hemiptera) exhibits deep divergence and accelerated substitution rates in Sternorrhyncha (whiteflies/aphids).

report_only_clades.name: Sternorrhyncha (Aleyrodidae + Aphididae)
report_only_clades.why_not_scored: Rapid rRNA and mitochondrial substitution rates in Aleyrodidae vs. Aphididae cause long-branch sensitivity in single-gene trees.

report_only_clades.name: Curculionidae (PSHB Ambrosia & Grain Weevils)
report_only_clades.why_not_scored: Single-family check; rapid Scolytinae evolution vs. Sitophilus Dryophthorinae.
